description: This file defines a front-end component for a simple note-taking application. It manages notes state, provides UI for viewing, creating, editing, and deleting notes, and includes mock data for initial testing. The code is structured with React functional components, including handlers for UI interactions and developer notes for backend integration.

methods.name: NotesApp
methods.description: Main React component managing notes state, UI rendering, and interaction logic.

methods.name: NoteView
methods.description: Component for displaying a selected note with options to edit or delete.

methods.name: NoteForm
methods.description: Form component for creating or editing a note, handling user input.
